docs.summary: Lightbox component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use Lightbox when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions or supplementary information.
Lightbox should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve for important interactions that require user attention.

anatomy.description: Lightbox is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing.
